record.field: We could not process your sponsorship payment

field.name: body_html
field.p: We could not collect your monthly sponsorship payment: your card was declined. It may have expired or been replaced.
You can update your card in a minute using the secure link below. Any outstanding amount will be collected right away and your sponsorship will continue without interruption.

a.style: padding: 12px 18px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; color: #FFFFFF; border-color:#0054A6; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 0px; font-weight: 400; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background-image: none; background-color: #0054A6; border: 1px solid #0054A6; border-radius:3px

field.p: If you have already updated your card, you can safely ignore this email.
Thank you for your faithful support!

record.field: Reminder: your sponsorship payment is still outstanding

field.name: body_html
field.p: Two weeks ago we let you know that your monthly sponsorship payment could not be collected. The payment is still outstanding.
Please update your card using the secure link below - it only takes a minute, the outstanding amount is collected right away and your sponsorship continues without interruption.

a.style: padding: 12px 18px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; color: #FFFFFF; border-color:#0054A6; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 0px; font-weight: 400; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background-image: none; background-color: #0054A6; border: 1px solid #0054A6; border-radius:3px

field.p: If we do not hear from you, one of our team members will contact you personally.
Thank you for standing with your sponsored child!
